Version history without erasing evidence

v0.4 · static

The original static program-search arena established reproducible transformation search, routing, leave-one-out validation, and a catalog of useful visual primitives. Its historical evidence page records 40 runs, 5,284 run-task evaluations, 39 unique exact tasks, 33 tasks with best LOO 1.0, and 67.3 summed runtime hours. These are static diagnostics, not interactive ARC-AGI-3 solves.

v0.5 · interactive

The first interactive branch added eight micro-environment families, C0–C4, replay, resume, Track O/P separation, random-competitiveness auditing, and honest matched ablations. It correctly refused to promote the sophisticated mechanisms merely because they existed.

v0.5.1 · validity repair

The current release asks whether those mechanisms were causally alive. It adds common policy seeds, live compute budgets, terminal transition learning, operational C3 hypotheses, action-selecting C4 MDL, executed DCC outputs, and exact v0.4 skill transfer that can change an action.

Historical project pagev0.5 measured page

The working MDL×DCC loop

observe public frame ↓ extract objects / action affordances / changed cells ↓ retain competing causal models ↓ MDL: compare model cost + parameter cost + predictive residual ↓ DCC: EXPLORE ↔ EXECUTE ↔ RECOVER ├─ allocate live model and planner budgets ├─ request a safe probe ├─ permit or suppress static consultation └─ checkpoint / restore internal state only ↓ act once in the environment ↓ learn from the real transition, including terminal outcome

v0.5.1 makes each arrow executable and testable. A model, gate, or static skill receives no credit for appearing in a trace; it must alter a decision in a matched environment.

Targeted mechanism effects

v0.5.1 produced two concrete positive signals that the primary promotion table intentionally does not inflate. The exact v0.4 static skill reduces its diagnostic task to one action, and full MDL reduces actions on compact-rule transfer relative to MDL-off. These establish causal utility in targeted tests, not broad competition superiority.

Next decisive step

The frozen local v0.5.1 matrix is complete. Keep the targeted static-skill and compact-MDL wins, simplify components that did not generalize across the primary stratum, create harder non-random-competitive transfer families, and add a separate official adapter layer. The adapter must not relabel the local proxy as official RHAE, must not weaken the Track O/P firewall, and must preserve replayable evidence.

Claim boundary

This project tests an agent-engineering hypothesis: whether compact causal modeling plus persistent governance improves interactive adaptation under environmental-action constraints. A positive ARC result would support that methodological prior. It would not establish AC, consciousness ontology, QM, SR, GR, a Theory of Everything, AGI, or ASI.

Project narrative page. Current numerical claims are injected from authoritative v0.5.1 run ledgers; historical v0.4/v0.5 pages remain archived.
